1. Overview & System Rationale
Technical communication, calculus visualizations, and mathematical pedagogy require specialized annotation entities:

items: **[`Arrow`](https://github.com/abhilasbiswas/Retiam/blob/main/src/engine/entities/composites/geometry/Arrow.ts) & [`Arrow3D`](https://github.com/abhilasbiswas/Retiam/blob/main/src/engine/entities/composites/geometry/Arrow3D.ts)**: Configurable vector arrows, dimension markers, and curved connectors with 10 tip geometry types and independent start/end heads.

**[`Brace`](https://github.com/abhilasbiswas/Retiam/blob/main/src/engine/entities/composites/geometry/Brace.ts)**: Procedural mathematical curly brackets that conform to entity bounding boxes and position label annotations (`Text`, `Tex`) at their central cusp.

**[`PixelGrid`](https://github.com/abhilasbiswas/Retiam/blob/main/src/engine/entities/composites/geometry/PixelGrid.ts)**: Subdivided 2D tile matrices for visual matrix arithmetic, image processing explanations, and conformal space deformations.

blocks.text: 2. Advanced Arrow Architecture ([Arrow.ts](../src/engine/entities/composites/geometry/Arrow.ts))
The `Arrow` composite combines an extruded path shaft with procedurally generated arrowhead geometry:
A. Arrow Tip Taxonomy (ArrowTipType)
Retiam provides 10 tip geometries tailored for distinct technical fields:

items: **`stealth`**: Aerodynamic swept-wing arrowhead with indented base.
**`circle` & `dot`**: Filled and unfilled circular terminals for network graphs and state machines.
**`diamond`**: Rhomboid pointer for UML and flowcharts.
**`bar` & `tee`**: Orthogonal end-caps for engineering dimension lines and interval markers.

C. Entity-to-Entity Connection (Arrow.between())

`Arrow.between(entA, entB)` computes the ray between entity centroids, intersects each entity's AABB boundary, adds clearance margins, and registers reactive listeners via `scene.always()` so the arrow tracks moving targets smoothly.
3. Mathematical Curly Braces ([Brace.ts](../src/engine/entities/composites/geometry/Brace.ts))

The `Brace` entity constructs a symmetrical, cubic Bézier curly bracket bounding a single entity, an array of entities, or a [`Group`](https://github.com/abhilasbiswas/Retiam/blob/main/src/engine/_core/Group.ts).
A. Procedural Curve Formulation
A brace consists of four coordinated cubic Bézier segments parameterized by length $L$, directional normal $\vec{n} \in \{\text{UP}, \text{DOWN}, \text{LEFT}, \text{RIGHT}\}$, and sharpness $r$:

items: **Outer End Quarter 1**: Curves from the outer boundary toward the center line.
**Outer Straight Inset**: Linear connector along the span.
**Central Cusp Outward**: Curves outward to form the pointing tip ($\star$).
**Symmetrical Return**: Mirrored segments completing the bracket.

4. Subdivided Pixel Grids ([PixelGrid.ts](../src/engine/entities/composites/geometry/PixelGrid.ts))
The `PixelGrid` renders a 2D matrix of colored cells with subdivided perimeter vertices:

items: **Edge Subdivisions (`edgeSubdivisions: 6`)**: Rather than 4 rigid corner vertices, each tile edge contains multiple collinear points.

**Deformation Resiliency**: When subjected to non-linear spatial mappings (such as complex conformal functions $f(z) = z^2$ or gravity vector fields), each individual pixel tile bends and curves smoothly along the grid lines without breaking topology.
